audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Skill while every caption on the same page said the opposite: whys[0..2] give the early levels to Pantheon, whys[5] calls the first item a coinflip and whys[6] gives two items back to him. The packet chart agrees with the captions.
audit.why: The page rendered 'Volibear wins Level 1' next to a caption reading 'Level 1 Pantheon's point-and-click W stun and Q poke beat your early all-in'. The mirror agent left its side as found and escalated this exact chart as its highest-priority open question, so no direction was pinned against me.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side and win[0..6] both set to Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Pantheon — the packet chart — with ratings 3, 3, 4, 6, 7, 5, 4.

audit.why: Spike shape is right: his levels 1-3, your 4-6 window, an even first item, his two-item roam game. Only the captions needed real numbers.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now carries Comet Spear's 8s max-rank timer instead of the invented 'W shred'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things the page got wrong about Aegis Assault. It said the E 'blocks your entire trade from one direction' without ever saying WHICH direction or that it is a channel, and dontsFull[1] warns about a 'W execute' that does not exist anywhere in Pantheon's kit.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is invulnerability to damage FROM THE FRONT and it is a channel — any CC ends it. That makes Thundering Smash the answer to it and makes walking behind him the other answer. Told only 'he blocks one direction', a player waits the full 18-22s out for nothing.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault: 400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s, invulnerable from the front while channelling, interruptible. Shield Vault: 600-range dash, stun, auto-reset, 13/12/11/10/9s. Comet Spear: 575, 11s to 8s. Grand Starfall: 5500 range, 180/165/150s. No execute exists in the kit.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade, but Comet Spear pokes from 575 and Shield Vault stuns on demand — take the level as chip, not a fight.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Pantheon has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, yet Shield Vault dashes 600 and stuns before your 300-unit charge lands — respect its 13s timer at rank 1.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Pantheon under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows and shields you inside the blast, but Aegis Assault leaves him invulnerable from the front for the whole channel.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Pantheon under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer online — leap in, disable his tower, and out-sustain the front-loaded burst. Levels 4-6 are the strongest your lane will be.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Pantheon to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but it is a coin now: his W stun into the E block, or your leap and the double bite first.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Pantheon can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items Grand Starfall lets him leave the lane entirely and snowball at 5500 range — deny the roams or the map decides this one.

edits.before: Pantheon dominates the early levels. His Q Comet Spear pokes you down from range, W Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun that starts his all-in, and E Aegis Assault blocks your entire trade from one direction. Don't try to fight into his combo — soak XP and wait for the mid-game to swing.
edits.after: Pantheon dominates the early levels. Comet Spear pokes from 575, Shield Vault dashes 600 and stuns on command, and Aegis Assault blocks damage only from the front — step around him or stun him out of the channel, never stand in front of it. Soak XP and wait for your level 4-6 window.

edits.before: You spike back at 4-6. Once you have your full kit and R Stormbringer, you out-sustain and out-scale Pantheon's front-loaded burst — leap on him with R, Q stun, and W shred and you beat him in an extended fight now that his poke can't finish you.
edits.after: You spike back at 4-6. With your full kit and Stormbringer you out-sustain his front-loaded burst — leap in, Thundering Smash for the stun, then cash both Frenzied Maul bites. Comet Spear is 8s at max rank and no longer finishes you.

edits.before: Track Pantheon's Shield Vault (Stun): His all-in start. Bait it. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks damage only from the front and it is a channel — stun it, or step behind him.

edits.before: Sit low for his W execute
edits.after: Stand in front of his E

edits.before: Trade into his W stun. Sit low for his W execute. Fight his early even. Stormbringer disables towers — your dive at 6 is the hardest punish in the lane, don't waste it on chip damage.
edits.after: Trade into his W stun. Stand in front of his E channel. Fight his early even. Stormbringer disables towers — your dive at 6 is the hardest punish in the lane, don't waste it on chip.

edits.before: You spike levels 3-6 hard — that's the kill window. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Your window is levels 4-6, not level 3. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points either side.
